chunks: Muthannā ibn al-Walīd al-Ḥannāṭ narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “When one of you marries, what should he do?” I said, “I do not know, may I be your ransom.”

He said: “When he intends that, let him perform two rakʿahs, praise Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and say: O Allah, I intend marriage, so decree for me, from among women, the one who is most chaste in private part, the most preserving for me with regard to herself and my wealth, the most expansive of them in provision, and the greatest of them in blessing. And appoint for me from her a good child whom You make for me a righteous successor in my life and after my death.”

key_terms.التَّزْوِيجَ: marriage; the act of seeking to marry
key_terms.خَلَفًا صَالِحًا: a righteous successor or continuing legacy
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two units of prayer performed before making the supplication
key_terms.رِزْقًا: provision or sustenance granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: What supplication should a person recite when intending to marry?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a recommended supplication and prayer for one intending marriage. It emphasizes beginning marriage with salat, praise of Allah, seeking a chaste and trustworthy spouse, abundant blessing and provision, and righteous offspring.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4387 - Muthanna ibn al-Walid al-Hannat narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

Abu Abdillah (as) said to me: "When one of you intends to get married, what should he do?"
I replied: "I do not know, may I be your ransom."

Imam (as) said: "When he makes up his mind for that, let him perform two units of prayer, praise Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, and say:
'O Allah (swt), I intend marriage, so decree for me from among the women the one who is most chaste in her private parts, best in preserving herself for me, my wealth, and the most abundant in sustenance, and the greatest in blessings. Grant me from her a good offspring whom You (swt) make for me a righteous successor during my life and after my death.'"
